description: Governor's Office - Western Province - Extended the period of Investigation of Single Person Inquiry Board
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the extension of an inquiry being conducted by a judicial figure (retired Judge of the Court of Appeal) into potential offenses committed by a local government body and its chairman. The content is focused on a legal/judicial proceeding and the appointment/authority of a specific judicial officer to conduct it, which falls squarely under the Judicial/Law Enforcement category (Type 9).
